news.title: Augustana School of Music Celebrates 89 Years of Christmas Vespers With Three Services
news.summary_en: TheAugustana Office of Faith & Spiritual LifeandAugustana School of Music (SoM)is inviting the public to join the university community for its 89th annual Christmas Vespers: “A Journey to Light," with services taking place on Dec. 4 and 5.
